x = sp.symbols('x')
c2, c1, c0 = sp.symbols('c2 c1 c0')

# Define the right-hand side of the equation
rhs = (x - 3)**3 + c2 * (x - 3)**2 + c1 * (x - 3) + c0

# Expand the right-hand side
rhs_expanded = sp.expand(rhs)

# Define the left-hand side of the equation
lhs = x**3 + x**2 - 5

# Extract coefficients from the expanded right-hand side
coeffs_rhs = sp.Poly(rhs_expanded, x).all_coeffs()
coeffs_lhs = sp.Poly(lhs, x).all_coeffs()

# Create equations by matching the coefficients
equations = [sp.Eq(lhs_coeff, rhs_coeff) for lhs_coeff, rhs_coeff in zip(coeffs_lhs, coeffs_rhs)]

# Solve the system of equations for c2, c1, c0
solution = sp.solve(equations, (c2, c1, c0))

# Extract the values of c2, c1, c0
c2_val = solution[c2]
c1_val = solution[c1]
c0_val = solution[c0]

# Compute c2^2 + c1^2 + c0^2
result = c2_val**2 + c1_val**2 + c0_val**2

# Print the result
print(result)
